title: Introduce yourself
prompt: Write a short introduction about yourself.
instructions: Include your name, where you are from, and one thing you like.

title: A good weekend
prompt: Write about what you did last weekend.
instructions: Describe two or three activities and say how you felt.

title: An email to a friend
prompt: Write an email recommending a place in your city.
instructions: Explain what the place is like, why you recommend it, and one practical tip.

title: A problem and a solution
prompt: Describe a common problem in your daily routine and propose a solution.

title: Remote work
prompt: Write a balanced opinion about remote work.
instructions: Discuss advantages and disadvantages and give your own conclusion.

title: Technology and public services
prompt: Discuss how technology can improve public services while creating new risks.
instructions: Present a clear position, support it with examples, and acknowledge limitations.

title: When metrics shape behaviour
prompt: Evaluate the claim that measuring performance can change the behaviour being measured.
instructions: Write a nuanced argument with a counterargument and a qualified conclusion.
